label: Easy Blur
description: Pick a video or image, draw boxes over what should stay hidden — faces, plates, names — and get the same media back with those regions blurred or pixelated. Audio untouched.

sourceId.label: Source
sourceId.description: The video or image to blur regions of.

regions.label: Blur regions
regions.description: Areas to hide — draw them on the preview. For pixel-precise placement, the JSON escape hatch takes { "canvas": { "w", "h" }, "regions": [{ "x", "y", "w", "h" }, …] }, integer px (omit canvas to give px in the media's own canvas; overshoot is clamped). No regions = the media passes through untouched.

strength.label: Strength
strength.description: Effect strength. Blur: gaussian sigma in px (1-200). Pixelate: block size in px (2-128). Default 24.

geometry.label: Geometry
geometry.description: How regions become document structure. "inset" (default): real m0 cells on a compact lattice, insets recover exact bounds. "exact": real m0 cells at exact px (longer DSL). "mask": one masked full-canvas overlay — no region geometry in the m0, cheapest render for many regions, softest region edges.
